explication: Rakazo is a multi-client platform for persistent AI teammates. A user signs in through the web, desktop, or mobile client, sends a message or configures a routine, and receives an agent result in a conversation, notification, or external messaging channel. The API authenticates and dispatches RPC operations, while agent adapters connect models, computers, memory, voice, and integrations. PostgreSQL persists workspace state. The graph preserves documented capabilities; several internal runtime links are inferred only from module boundaries and README descriptions.
